method: Each direct pair is separately assessed in both directions against actual displayed labels and independent character/complete word records. No exclusion is inherited transitively. No-new-guard is bounded and retains explicit uncertainty.
sourceReadingLimits: KANJIDIC2 lists ハン and no kun for 範, with nanori のり; Daijisen independently lists kun のり and nanori すすむ. JMdict 1438050 has normative, Buddhist, measurement and engineering senses; its shared spellings and unrestricted senses do not prove equal naturalness or frequency.
preservedOtherGuards: 式 幅 律 憲 域 般 類 制 程 令 remain declared on 範 as in the initial candidate, without a new claim of transitive exclusion.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: A mark/signpost/goal is not the standard model itself; 標準 is a whole word for a standard.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: A model/standard label is plausible against the standard association of 標準, so guard conservatively.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen 標 gives mark/goal and includes 標準 among examples; the compound alone does not establish standard as a constituent synonym.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: A chronicle is not a model; 紀's separate discipline branch is relevant to normative rules.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard can be plausible against its independent rule/code-of-conduct branch.
pairs.limitations: 紀律 is marked rarely used for that spelling; Daijisen 紀 supplies its separate character-level rules sense.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Mirror/lens is not generally a standard, but the character entry separately gives an instructive model.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: The model label directly fits that secondary character sense.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen 鏡 gives the model-to-learn-from branch; JMdict 2017840 marks 鏡 search-only, so do not equate spellings or infer frequency.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Manner and an honorific are not themselves a standard; ためし is a separate example/precedent sense.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard can be defensible for an example/precedent.
pairs.limitations: JMdict lists 様 with 例 for ためし, but no frequency follows from an absent rarity flag; no reading metadata changed.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Rank/character is not automatically a model; 格/かく also has rules and regulations.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard can be plausible for its normative rule branch.
pairs.limitations: JMdict 1205270 gives the unfielded rule branch; KANJIDIC2 alone does not. Do not equate rank, personality or grammatical case with a model.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Shape/form includes abstract form and style; a standard pattern is a specific form rather than any outline.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard can suggest a model form, although it is not every form.
pairs.limitations: Conservative overlap with Daijisen 範's standard 型; not unrestricted equivalence of 形 and 範.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Book/origin is not a normative model or a delimited frame.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not established as an ordinary 本 sense by the cited independent 本 entries.
pairs.limitations: 手本 means model as a whole word; that alone does not allocate model to 本. Other lexical uses remain outside this bounded evidence.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Imitate/emulate denotes following an example, not the exemplar itself.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: English model can also denote modeling on or imitating; protect the association conservatively.
pairs.limitations: The Japanese example and the act of following it remain distinct; no unrestricted substitution is claimed.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Image/statue includes mental and representational images, but those are not automatically a normative exemplar.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard could loosely suggest a representation, but the independently selected 像 record supplies image/figure, not a normative model.
pairs.limitations: Physical and mental representation both retained; a broader representational model ambiguity remains uncertain rather than disproved.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Surround/enclose includes making an enclosure; 範 has a delimited frame, but does not independently mean to surround or enclose.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not a defensible label for enclosure under the selected independent 囲 and 範 senses.
pairs.limitations: KANJIDIC2 囲 includes enclosure and encircle; 範囲 is a whole word and not an independent allocation of its entire scope sense to 囲. Frame-versus-enclosure boundary remains contextual.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Limit overlaps the edge or bound of a delimited frame, not necessarily its whole area.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard itself differs from limit, but the prompt also has the sourced bounds branch.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen 限 describes setting a scope and a limit; conservative direct guard, not equivalence.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Boundary/border and the region branch overlap the frame and scope comparison.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is distinct from a boundary, but 範's secondary delimited-frame branch warrants protection.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen 境 distinguishes boundary, delimited place and condition; a dividing line is not the full domain.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: World/boundary includes boundary and a delimited domain relevant to the frame branch.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is distinct from world, but the secondary bounded-frame comparison is protected.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen 界 gives boundary and bounded domain; the sense is not restricted to the planet, nor are line and area interchangeable.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Wide/spacious is distinct from a normative model, but 範 also has a sourced widespread branch.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is distinct from width, while the independent spread/wide association supports a conservative pair.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen 範 supplies widespread as a separate sense; 広範 is a whole word and not proof that both constituents always mean wide.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Direction/method includes side, category and field, but no selected 範 evidence says direction or general method.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not established as an ordinary 方 meaning by the selected entries.
pairs.limitations: 範疇 is a whole word for category; a rule may prescribe a method without being the method. Contextual overlap remains possible.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Degree/number of times includes extent and limit, whereas のり can mean a transverse measurement.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not established as a 度 meaning by these records; measuring scale and an occurrence are not automatically a normative model.
pairs.limitations: Retain extent and measure, not merely occurrence; selected sources do not settle every specialized measurement context.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Road/way also includes moral principles or rules for conduct; that overlaps normative のり.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is plausible at the conduct-guiding branch, not for every road.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen のり distinguishes normative conduct and distance; the source spelling and usage do not make 範 an interchangeable road spelling.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Measure/plan includes action and a measuring device; のり includes transverse measurement.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not established as a 計 meaning by these selected entries.
pairs.limitations: A measurement result or scale may relate to measuring without being the same label; shared spellings in 1600650 do not establish free substitution. Borderline technical contexts remain uncertain.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Measure/gauge includes surveying and estimation, while のり includes measurement across.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not established as 測's ordinary meaning by the selected records.
pairs.limitations: Measurement overlap is retained; no claim that 範/のり is natural in every はかる context or that abstract estimation is physical.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Quantity/amount and measurement across can be related, but a quantity is not automatically a standard or exemplar.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is not established as 量's meaning by the selected records.
pairs.limitations: The verb 量る and surveying are included; spelling appropriateness cannot be inferred merely from the shared はかる entry.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Slope/incline overlaps JMdict's engineering side-slope sense in the のり entry containing 範.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard differs from an ordinary slope, but the technical secondary sense justifies conservative protection.
pairs.limitations: Engineering is explicitly field-marked; Daijisen marks 範 as a nonpreferred spelling for のり. No everyday slope frequency or universal spelling equivalence is inferred.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Reason/logic includes principle, while のり includes rules of conduct.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard can be associated with an underlying principle but selected 理 evidence does not establish an exemplar or normative standard as its ordinary label.
pairs.limitations: Daijisen のり's human 道理 is retained; logical reasons and behavioral rules can be related without being synonymous. Borderline contexts remain uncertain.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Teacher/specialist is not necessarily a model, but KANJIDIC2 explicitly lists model and exemplar for 師.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard can match that character-dictionary branch.
pairs.limitations: Full KANJIDIC2 師 is supplied here; the initial review evidence did not include it and its original uncertainty remains unchanged.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Elephant/image/shape differs from a normative exemplar; 象る can mean model on or represent.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard may be confused with the modeling-related sense, conservatively guarded.
pairs.limitations: Action/representation and a standard to follow are distinct; JMdict's spelling and reading qualifications remain in the full record.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Ceremony/formal conduct differs from a model, although whole words 儀範 and 地球儀 denote a model or globe.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model/standard is conservatively guarded, without asserting a proven constituent 儀=model meaning.
pairs.limitations: KANJIDIC2 gives ceremony/rule/affair/case/matter, not model; neither whole word proves 儀 alone means model. The initial audit's broader wording is corrected here.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Model and standard form directly overlap 範's model and pattern.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Model and standard form directly overlap 範's model and pattern.
pairs.limitations: Not every physical mold or type is a normative standard.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Example and precedent directly overlap the model/example branch.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Example and precedent directly overlap the model/example branch.
pairs.limitations: An example is not necessarily a rule.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: The actual standard/rule label overlaps 範's standard and normative branch.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: The actual standard/rule label overlaps 範's standard and normative branch.
pairs.limitations: The whole word 規範 does not alone establish every constituent sense.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Rule and follow-a-model senses overlap the normative/model branch.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Rule and follow-a-model senses overlap the normative/model branch.
pairs.limitations: Following an example and the example itself are different.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Law and method include the rule branch also recorded for 範/のり.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Law and method include the rule branch also recorded for 範/のり.
pairs.limitations: A method is not necessarily a law; shared のり spellings do not prove equal naturalness.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: Rules and the のり word-family association support the existing conservative guard.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: Rules and the のり word-family association support the existing conservative guard.
pairs.limitations: Reference texts and ceremonies are not necessarily models.

pairs.prompt範_labelComparison: The displayed standard/conform label overlaps the standard/model branch.
pairs.promptComparison_label範: The displayed standard/conform label overlaps the standard/model branch.
pairs.limitations: Standard and conformity to a model are related but not universally interchangeable.
